name: Lisa Michelle Dabbs
office: East Whittier City School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Lisa Michelle Dabbs is the President of the East Whittier City School District Governing Board and was first elected in 2018. She is a former teacher, principal, and federal project director. In a 2026 candidate questionnaire, she highlighted fiscal responsibility and school safety as key needs, stating she has worked on responsible budgeting to protect classroom resources. Her campaign says she supports investments in technology and the arts, and greater support for teachers and staff. She also advocates for district transparency and broadening access to educational resources.
